description: Defines the class FormatWithAchievement implementing ValueFormatter to format achievement-related values as strings.

classes.name: FormatWithAchievement
classes.description: A class that implements ValueFormatter to convert achievement status codes into display strings.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted string for a given achievement value; 'Positive' for ACHIEVEMENT_POSITIVE, 'Negative' for ACHIEVEMENT_NEGATTIVE, null otherwise.
